summary: Comprehensive testing of PDF viewing and quote validity features for PDPV. All backend and frontend features verified working. One critical bug found and fixed in QuoteResponse.js (missing useSearchParams import). All 13 backend tests pass. All 6 frontend feature flows verified.

issues: Comments textarea is not visually greyed out when quote is expired (disabled attr set but CSS contrast could be improved)

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: QuoteResponse.js line 30 used `useSearchParams` but was not imported from 'react-router-dom' - would cause runtime crash on public quote page. Fixed by adding useSearchParams to import on line 2.

Download endpoint (/api/public/quote/{token}/attachments/{id}/download) does NOT check quote link expiry (expires_at) - it only validates the token exists. Minor security note: files can still be downloaded after the 7-day link expires. Not blocking.
